note: Rejudged at HEAD after applyTransition converted its sessionEndedAt reason/cause if-else chain to a switch statement (no behavior change). Re-read RFC 1661 Section 4.4 (zrc): 'In addition to zeroing the Restart counter, the implementation MUST set the timeout period to an appropriate value.' Producer applyTransition still runs s.restartCount = 0 and s.armRestartTimer() on LCPActZRC, and armRestartTimer resets s.restartTimer to s.lcpConfig.RestartTimer(). TestConfiguredLCPZeroRestartPeriod and TestLCPPeerTerminateRestartTimer (both synctest) assert that Opened+RTR zeroes a live counter and arms the exact configured 500 ms / default 3 s grace timer before Stopped, contrasted against Closed+RTR which sends Terminate-Ack without arming any timer. Verdict stands.
